name: India–Pakistan
value: Airspace ban to 24 Nov; no strikes found
summary: Pakistan's airspace ban on Indian aircraft runs to 24 Nov; treaty suspensions continue and no strike was found
state: Pakistan extended its ban on Indian-operated aircraft in its airspace to 24 Nov, renewing a closure in place since the April 2025 Pahalgam attack (Express Tribune, 18 Oct). India's suspension of the Indus Waters Treaty and Pakistan's suspension of bilateral agreements remain in place. Searches on 12 Nov found no new Line of Control incident, cross-border strike or mobilisation. Ongoing treaty suspensions keep Watch.
for_you: Flights between Europe and India may take longer routes around Pakistani airspace. Travellers to the region should check FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Treaty suspensions in place (Indus Waters Treaty, airspace bans) (Watch); no cross-border strikes

sources.title: Express Tribune — Pakistan extends airspace ban on Indian aircraft until Nov 24

why: Two nuclear-armed neighbours with a history of rapid escalation after terrorist attacks.
drivers: Kashmir attacks, Line of Control firing, water disputes (Indus), domestic politics.

rubric.watch: Ceasefire violations, a major terrorist attack with blame assigned, or treaty suspensions.
rubric.normal: Ceasefire holding along the Line of Control; no major attacks.
